name: CN-02 Lead AI Extraction and Standard v1 Scoring

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $vars.AI_EXTRACTION_MODEL || 'qwen3.7-plus', temperature: 0, thinking: $env.AI_PROVIDER === 'deepseek' ? { type: 'disabled' } : undefined, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'Return one valid JSON object. Extract structured evidence only; never calculate or return a score, weight, priority, pass/fail decision, or opportunity decision. Never guess. Return extracted_evidence with exactly these dimensions: need_clarity {status known|unknown, level detailed|defined|vague, evidence}; budget_fit {status, amount, evidence}; decision_authority {status, level decision_maker|recommender|influencer|other, role, evidence}; urgency {status, timeframe_days, level immediate|high|medium|low, evidence}; customer_fit {status, industry, company_size, region, use_case, buyer_role, signals[], excluded_signal, evidence}; engagement {status, level high|medium|low, evidence}. Also return extraction confidence from 0 to 1, missing_information[], and recommended_next_action. Write all user-facing free text, including evidence, missing_information, and recommended_next_action, in concise Simplified Chinese. Keep only schema keys and the required enum values in English. Use null for unknown facts.' }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify({ lead: $('Read Lead Context').first().json, scoring_profile: $json }) }] }) }}
